test_name: Stun Lock overheat missing in left arm socket - d442db34-7119-4b5c-83e5-398cb35145c8
summary: Stun Lock only overheated a bot when the hit that finished filling its stun meter came straight from the arm, like a Jack face hit. Usually the meter fills when the bot crashes after being knocked back, and that crash counted as the bot's own, so no overheat. The crash already credits the player 'in hindsight' (last hitter, thrower or holder), so the stun now keeps that credit and Stun Lock acts on stuns credited to its arm. In the editor, with Stun Lock on the left arm: a crash credited to the left arm stunned and overheated a Junkdog, a Focused Blaster shot stunned and overheated one, and the same crash credited to the right arm only stunned. Direct hits and Over Stun behave as before.
